text:
alex: Heads-up: nightly e2e perf gate failed for the convo workload — p99 latency jumped ~+18% vs baseline. CI job 9857. Initial pass shows spike after seq>1024.
perfbot: :warning: Alert from nightly-perf: p99 +18% (210ms -> 248ms). See graph: https://perf.example.com/runs/9857

maria: Thanks. Any runtime or infra commits in the window? Could be a serving-runtime tweak or KV cache change.

ci-bot: Blame range for job 9857: commits 9b3c1f4..d4e2aab. Notable PRs: #3124 (reduce-kv-cache-sync), #3119 (batching-tweak). Rerun command: ```./tools/ci rerun 9857 --preserve-env```

sam: I'll kick off a rerun with warm cache and take the first bisect if it repros. ETA ~15m.

alex: If rerun passes it's likely noisy infra; if it fails we should bisect. Also flagging that #3119 touched batching heuristics — worth keeping in mind.

jia: Pulling logs now. Quick look: p50 almost flat, p95 up ~6%, p99 spike concentrated in requests with seq >1024. Snippet from failed host:
```
[2026-03-02T03:12:05Z] request_id=abc123 seq_len=1536 kv_cache: sync_time_ms=42
[2026-03-02T03:12:05Z] request_id=abc123 model_step=120 p99_emit=246ms
```

sam: Rerun started (9857-rerun-1). Warmup 120s, same config as nightly. Will post results.

perfbot: Run 9857-rerun-1 complete: p99 still +15% vs baseline. https://perf.example.com/runs/9857-rerun-1

sam: Starting binary bisect across commits 9b3c1f4..d4e2aab (step=3). Will report first suspect commit.

maria: Can we also try disabling KV cache sync as a quick isolate? @sam can you run kv_cache=false in a quick experiment?

sam: Launched 9857-kv-off with kv_cache=false. If that recovers p99, PR #3124 is the likely cause.

ci-bot: 9857-kv-off finished: p99 back to baseline (-1% delta). Evidence suggests KV cache sync in #3124 introduced regression.

alex: Good catch. Action: revert or patch the KV sync change. For now revert the offending commit in nightly to keep gates green (rollback to commit 9b3c1f4).

maria: :thumbsup: I'll open a revert PR and notify the release channel. Sam, can you paste repro steps + logs into the ticket?

sam: Repro steps:
```
./tools/run_e2e --profile conv --seqmax 2048 --concurrency 32 --warmup 120
```
Key log line: `kv_cache: sync_time_ms=42` vs baseline `sync_time_ms=2` for seq>1024. I'll attach the full logs to the issue.

jia: Filed INF-743 with logs, graphs, and failing job links. @maria please add revert PR link when ready.

alex: Thanks all — leaving thread open until revert is merged and nightly passes again.
